package.name: indoor_nav
package.description: Indoor GNSS simulation: gnss_sim_node fuses FCC-relayed attitude/baro altitude with a downward optical-flow sensor into a local dead-reckoned position/velocity estimate (INDOOR-GNSS-SIMULATION-BACKLOG.md, IGS-001), converts it to a WGS-84 fix anchored at an operator-declared false origin with a growing eph/epv uncertainty model (IGS-003), and streams it to the FCC as a MAVLink HIL_GPS frame over a new dedicated MC->FCC UDP channel (IGS-004; see that ticket's own firmware-verification note for why HIL_GPS, not this proposal's original "GPS_INPUT" guess).
